blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Weight quantization below four bits shrinks memory and bandwidth at a perplexity that looks acceptable, but often at the cost of factual knowledge and task accuracy. Ternary weights have mostly been obtained by training from scratch or long fine-tuning. We introduce RoleQ, a quantization framework that places scales by the functional roles of Transformer units rather than by the layout of the weight matrix, as conventional formats do. Vectors that read from the residual stream take one scale per output unit; those that write to it, one per input unit. The rule is structural, needs no search, calibration or stored state, and holds on integer and ternary grids. In a rotated basis it matches a per-layer axis search at half the solver work, and at ternary it cuts perplexity by up to half against layout-based placement in two families at every size from 0.6B to 14B, where per-row scales leave MMLU at chance. Our lightweight post-training pipeline converts an existing checkpoint to 1.59 bits per weight in a few GPU-hours, a fraction of the cost of learned ternarization, and leads every post-training ternary method at matched or lower memory-resident bits on perplexity, zero-shot accuracy and MMLU, most widely on knowledge. A sparse second ternary plane placed by a per-unit Fisher saliency keeps the matmul multiplication-free and recovers what ternary loses first: at 8B, a fraction of a bit returns about half the MMLU that conversion costs, well ahead of random or Hessian-based placement at equal bits.
blocks.zh: 4个比特以下的重量量子化会收缩内存和带宽,其复杂性看起来可以接受,但往往以事实知识和任务准确性为代价. 初等体重大多通过从零开始或长期微调的训练获得. 我们引入了"角色Q"(Locus Q),一个量化框架,按照变形器单元的功能作用,而不是像常规格式那样按照权重矩阵的布局来放出尺度. 从残流读取的矢量每个输出单位取一个比例;写给它的矢量,每个输入单位取一个比例. 规则是结构的,不需要搜索,校正或存储状态,并坚持整数和三相网格. 在旋转的基础上,它与半个溶解器工作的每层轴搜索相匹配,在三分点时,它与基于布局的布局在大小从0.6B到14B两个家庭的安置相比,将复杂度削减了多至一半,每行平面可能留下MMLU。 我们的轻量级训练后管线在几小时的GPU中将现有的检查点转换为每重量1.59比特,这是所学取的三角化成本的一小部分,并且将每个训练后三角化方法以相匹配或较低的内存-居民比特(英语:Content-ternary bits)引导到迷惑性,零发精度和MMLU,最广泛的是在知识上. 每个单位的Fisher saliency所放置的稀疏的第二三相平面保持了matmul相乘的无阻性,并恢复了Ternary首先失去的东西:在8B时,有一小部分的微分返回了大约一半的MMLU的转换成本,远远领先于随机或以黑森为主的平分放置在等位.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Weight memory and bandwidth constrain language-model deployment on phones and in browsers. At batch size one, decoding is typically bandwidth-bound, making bits per weight a key determinant of latency ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) , motivating ultra-low-bit quantization. Below four bits, however, acceptable perplexity can conceal severe losses in factual knowledge and task accuracy. We therefore evaluate quantization with three complementary measures: WikiText2 perplexity, a seven-task zero-shot average and five-shot MMLU.
blocks.zh: 重量内存和带宽限制了语言模型在手机和浏览器上的部署. 在批量尺寸1时,解码通常带宽,使比特/重量成为延迟的关键决定因素(Wang等人,2025年;Wei等人,2025年),激发超低位量化. 然而,在四个比特以下,可接受的模糊性可以掩盖事实知识和任务准确性方面的严重损失。 因此,我们用三个补充措施来评估量化:WikiText2 疑惑度,一个七任务零射平均值和五个MMLU.

blocks.en: Ternary weights replace weight multiplications with additions and subtractions. Pretraining ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) , quantization-aware training ( Liu et al., 2025c ) , code fine-tuning ( Malinovskii et al., 2024 ) and learned ternarization over many epochs ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026b ) preserve much of the model’s knowledge at substantial computational cost. Post-training conversion ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026a ; Guo et al., 2026 ) is much cheaper but loses factual knowledge: on Qwen3-8B-Base, these methods score 26–35 on MMLU, versus 77 at full precision. The challenge is to approach training-based retention at post-training conversion cost.
blocks.zh: 第三重用增减代替重乘法. Pretraining (Wang et al., 2023; Ma et al., 2024), quantization-aware training (Liu et al., 2025c), 代码微调(Malinovskii et al., 2024), 以及在许多纪元上学习到的ternarization(Wang et al., 2026c;Wang et al., 2026b)以大量的计算成本保存了模型的大部分知识. 训练后转换(张等,2026年;颜等,2026年a;郭等,2026年)成本低得多,但丧失了事实知识:在Qune3-8B-Base上,这些方法在MMLU上得分26–35,在完全精准的情况下对77. 目前的挑战是如何以培训后转换费用对待基于培训的留用问题。

blocks.en: Our central insight is that quantization should allocate bits by function. We introduce RoleQ, a format that assigns scales to functional units: vectors that read from the residual stream receive one scale per output unit; vectors that write to it receive one per input unit. This structural rule applies to integer and ternary grids and requires neither calibration data nor stored axis choices. RoleQ-T combines this format with a data-free learned rotation, ternary GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2023 ) with an exact per-vector step, and brief scale distillation with frozen codes (Figure 2 ). Qwen3-8B-Base ( Yang et al., 2025 ) reaches 1.59 bits per weight (bpw), 11.33 perplexity, 60.3 zero-shot accuracy and 47.6 MMLU in a few GPU-hours, a fraction of the tens of A100-hours for CAT-Q’s learned ternarization at this size (Section 4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的中心见解是,量化应该按功能分配位数. 我们引入了LocusQ,一种为功能单位分配天平的格式:从剩余流读取的矢量每个输出单位得到一个天平;向它写入的矢量每个输入单位得到一个天平. 这一结构规则适用于整数和三角网格,既不要求校准数据,也不要求存储轴选择. 角色Q-T将这种格式与无数据学习的旋转结合,Ternary GPTQ(Frantar等人,2023年),精确的每向量步骤,以及带有冷冻代码的短暂缩放(图2). Qune3-8B-Base(Yang等人,2025年)在几小时GPU中达到每重量1.59位(bpw),11.33位(bpw),60.3位(0射)精度和47.6位(MMLU),是CAT-Q’s在这种大小上学会的三角化的几十个A100小时的一小部分(第4.1节)。

blocks.en: Functional units also guide the allocation of extra bits. At a tight budget, selecting units by quantization-error magnitude can perform worse than random; per-unit Fisher saliency estimates how strongly each unit’s error affects the loss. RoleQ-T therefore optionally adds a sparse second ternary plane to Fisher-selected units, preserving multiplication-free matrix products. At 2.16 bpw, Qwen3-8B-Base reaches 9.30 perplexity, 65.9 zero-shot accuracy and 62.8 MMLU. On post-trained Qwen3-8B, 1.99 bpw surpasses CAT-Q on all three measures for 0.28 additional bits.
blocks.zh: 功能单位还指导额外比特的分配. 在预算紧张的情况下,按量化-过分规模选择单位的表现可能比随机性要差;每个单位的Fisher s显著性估计每个单位的错误对损失的影响有多大。 因此,角色Q-T可以选择在费舍尔选用的单元中增加一个稀疏的第二角平面,保留无乘法矩阵产品. 在2.16 bpw时,Quen3-8B-Base达到9.30的复杂度,65.9的零射精度和62.8 MMLU. 在训练后的Qwen3-8B上,1.99 bpw在所有三项措施上都超过了CAT-Q,增加了0.28位.

blocks.en: We make three contributions. 1. Role-aligned scale placement (Section 3.1 ). In a rotated basis, RoleQ matches AdaDim’s ( Heo et al., 2024 ) reconstruction quality at half the solver work of a two-way search, without calibration data or stored axis choices. Per-vector INT4 matches MXFP4 at 8% fewer bits; ternary perplexity improves over the best uniform placement by up to 2 × 2\times , with gains at every tested size from 0.6B to 14B across two families. At 14B, RoleQ raises MMLU from 25.4 (chance) with per-output-channel scales to 38.5. 2. Efficient ternary conversion (Sections 3.2 – 3.4 ). RoleQ-T outperforms Qronos, PT 2 -LLM and QTEA on all three measures at matched or lower memory-resident rates, with the largest gains on knowledge. At 14B, it surpasses QTEA’s released checkpoint after scale distillation using 0.67 fewer bpw. Applying the same distillation to PT 2 -LLM leaves it over four perplexity points behind at a higher rate. 3. Fisher-guided secondary planes (Section 3.5 ). At 8B, +0.57 bpw recovers about half the MMLU lost on Base. On the post-trained model at 1.99 bpw, Fisher selection beats random by 6.2 points and Hessian × \times weight by 9.0.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献。 1. 角色表的排列(第3.1节)。 在旋转的基础上,角色Q匹配AdaDim's(Heo等人,2024年)重建质量,为双向搜索的解析器工作的一半,没有校准数据或存储轴选择. 每名潜水员INT4比MXFP4比比位数少8%;在最佳统一布局上,Ternary Proplexity改进了最多2×2\时,每个测试大小的增益从0.6B到14B在两个家庭. 在14B时,LocksQ将MMLU从每个输出通道的25.4(chance)级提高到38.5级. 2. 高效三胞胎转换(第3.2至3.4节)。 角色Q-T以匹配或较低的内存-内存率在所有三项措施上都超过了Qronos,PT 2-LLM和QTEA,在知识上收获最大. 在14B时,它超过QTEA在使用0.67个bpw进行规模蒸馏后释放的检查站。 将同样的蒸馏法应用于PT 2-LLM使其以更高的速率在四个偏差点上落后. 3. 渔业制导二级飞机(第3.5节)。 8B时,+0.57 bpw恢复了大约一半在基地损失的MMLU. 在1.99 bpw的训练后型号上,费舍尔选择以6.2分随机击败,赫西安×\times重量以9.0.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Ternary weights and conversion. Ternary weights { − 1 , 0 , + 1 } \{-1,0,+1\} date at least to Hwang and Sung (2014) ; ternary weight networks ( Li et al., 2016 ) popularised the scaled ternary code with a threshold rule. Following binary BitNet ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , BitNet b1.58 ( Ma et al., 2024 ) showed that language models pretrained with this alphabet can match full-precision counterparts at scale while enabling multiplication-free matrix products. Converting existing checkpoints avoids pretraining from scratch, but the computational cost varies. Quantization-aware training, distillation and code fine-tuning ( Liu et al., 2025c ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Malinovskii et al., 2024 ) still update weights or codes. Learned ternarization also involves sustained optimization: CAT-Q ( Wang et al., 2026c ) uses 512 calibration samples but optimises its codes for 60 epochs, while ScaleQ-1.58 ( Wang et al., 2026b ) uses the model’s own reasoning traces. Although CAT-Q is described as post-training quantization, we distinguish its extended code optimization from the lightweight conversion setting considered here. Direct post-training methods include Qronos ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , PT 2 -LLM ( Yan et al., 2026a ) , QTEA ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , PTQTP ( Xiao et al., 2025b ) and TWLA ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . We compare these methods at memory-resident rates (Appendix Tables 4 and 5 ), since several report sub-2-bit code counts that exclude strictly necessary decoding metadata. TWLA’s released implementation requires 4.15–4.65 bpw, so it serves as a reference rather than a bit-matched baseline. PTQTP adds a second plane to every unit, while QTEA adds FP8 residuals to curvature-selected columns; neither allocates these extra bits using a per-unit loss-sensitivity score.
blocks.zh: 初等重及转正. 三级权重 {− 1, 0, + 1}} → 1, 0, + 1\} 日期至少为黄和成(2014年); 三级权重网络(Li等人,2016年) 普及了有阈值规则的缩放三重码. 继二进制BitNet(Wang et al., 2023)之后,BitNet b1.58(Ma et al., 2024)显示,使用此字母表预先训练的语言模型可以在规模上匹配全精度对应物,同时允许无乘积矩阵产品. 转换现有的检查站可以避免从零开始预先训练,但计算成本各有不同。 量化认识培训、蒸馏和编码微调(刘等人,2025c); Wu等人,2025年;Malinovskii等人,2024年)仍在更新权重或代码. 学得的三角化也涉及持续优化:CAT-Q(Wang等人,2026c)使用512个校准样本,但选择了60个纪元的编码,而ScaleQ-1.58(Wang等人,2026b)则使用模型自己的推理痕迹. 虽然CAT-Q被描述为训练后的量化,但我们将其扩展代码优化与本文考虑的轻量级转换设置区分开来. 直接的训练后方法包括Qronos(张等,2026年),PT 2-LLM(颜等,2026年a),QTEA(郭等,2026年),PTQTP(萧等,2025年b)和TWLA(赵等,2026年b). 我们按内存-居民费率比较这些方法(附录表4和表5),因为若干报告次2位码数排除了严格必要的解码元数据. TWLA的发布实施需要4.15–4.65 bpw,因此它作为参考而不是比对的基准. PTQTP在每个单位中增加一个第二平面,而QTEA在曲率选择的列中增加FP8的残片;既不使用每个单位的损耗敏感分数来分配这些额外的位数.

blocks.en: Two-bit formats. QuIP# ( Tseng et al., 2024a ) and QTIP ( Tseng et al., 2024b ) use lattice and trellis codebooks, respectively, achieving strong two-bit results on Llama. GuidedQuant’s loss-guided Hessian ( Kim et al., 2025 ) and YAQA’s end-to-end adaptive rounding ( Tseng et al., 2026 ) build on QTIP’s trellis codes. QTIP adopts QuIP#-style fine-tuning, reported at 50–100 GPU-hours for a 70B model. These methods provide strong quality references. Our format is scalar and codebook-free, and its ternary codes also support multiplication-free matrix products. For a comparison within this format class, our equal-bits controls reproduce the uniform grouped grids used by GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2023 ) and EfficientQAT ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 双位格式. QuIP#(Tseng等人,2024a)和QTIP(Tseng等人,2024b)分别使用拉蒂斯和特雷利斯编码本,在Llama上取得了强大的双位结果. GuidedQuant的亏损导线Hessian(Kim等人,2025年)和YAQA的端对端适应性圆环(Tseng等人,2026年)基于QTIP的trillis代码. QTIP采用QuIP#风格的微调,报告为70B型的50~100GPU小时. 这些方法提供了很强的质量参考。 我们的格式是Scalar和无编码的,它的ternary代码也支持无乘法矩阵产品. 为了在本格式类中进行比较,我们的等位控制复制了GPTQ(Frantar等人,2023年)和高效QAT(Chen等人,2025年)使用的统一分组网格。

blocks.en: Scale axis and rotation. Existing methods choose scale axes empirically or refine scales within a solver. AdaDim ( Heo et al., 2024 ) selects per-input or per-output scales for each module through a reconstruction test without rotation, and reports lower quality when per-input scales are applied uniformly rather than selectively. ShiftAddLLM ( You et al., 2024 ) refits column scales during the solver’s sweep; Z-FOLD ( Jeon et al., 2023 ) adds a folded in-channel scale on a second axis, and D 2 Quant ( Yan et al., 2026b ) adds one for a single matrix type. We adopt Z-FOLD’s closed-form 𝐇 \mathbf{H} -metric refit for readers. These methods use calibration data and do not derive scale placement from vector roles. RoleQ instead selects the axis structurally from each vector’s reader or writer role, without calibration or stored axis flags. Our rotations retain the slots and parametrization of QuaRot ( Ashkboos et al., 2024 ) and SpinQuant ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , using SpinQuant’s notation. OptRot ( Gadhikar et al., 2025 ) and TWLA learn rotations without data, whereas HARP ( Zagitov et al., 2026 ) learns a stored rotation from calibration data before codebook quantization. Our rotation contribution is the choice of objective, evaluated against those of OptRot and TWLA.
blocks.zh: 缩放轴和旋转 。 现有方法在求解器内按经验选择尺度轴或精细尺度. AdaDim(Heo等人,2024年)通过不轮换的重建测试,为每个模块选择每输入或每输出比例,当每输入比例得到统一而不是有选择的应用时,报告质量较低. ShiftAddLM(You et al.,2024)在解析器扫荡时重置列标;Z-FOLD(Jeon et al.,2023)在第二个轴上加一个折叠的通道内标,D2 Quant(Yan et al.,2026b)为单一矩阵类型加一个. 我们采用 Z-FOLD 的闭式 H\ mathbf{H} - 为读者进行量度校正。 这些方法使用校准数据,不会从矢量作用中得出比例定位. 角色Q而是从每个矢量的读取器或刻录器角色中从结构上选择轴,而不进行校准或存储轴旗. 我们的轮换保留了QuaRot(Ashkboos等人,2024年)和SpinQuant(Liu等人,2025年b)的空档和空降,使用Spinquant的标记。 OptRot(Gidhikar等人,2025年)和TWLA在没有数据的情况下学习旋转,而HARP(Zagitov等人,2026年)则在代码分类之前从校准数据中学习存储旋转. 我们的轮换贡献是客观的选择,根据OptRot和TWLA的评估。

blocks.en: Saliency and mixed allocation. BiLLM ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and ARB-LLM ( Li et al., 2025 ) assign residual binary planes to columns selected by curvature scores. FGMP ( Hooper et al., 2025 ) allocates precision using ∑ g 2 ​ δ 2 \sum g^{2}\delta^{2} with a single global percentile, an allocator we adopt at unit granularity. MixLLM ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , SqueezeLLM ( Kim et al., 2024 ) and TaCQ ( Xiao et al., 2025a ) use gradient, Fisher and task-conditioned scores. We condition our score on factual recall and find that, at tight budgets, curvature-based selection can perform worse than random placement.

blocks.en: Figure 2: The RoleQ-T pipeline. A data-free learned rotation precedes ternary GPTQ with an exact per-vector step, giving codes in { − 1 , 0 , + 1 } \{-1,0,+1\} (grey) and one scale per functional unit (blue). blocks.en: 3.1 RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales
blocks.zh: 3.1 作用Q: 作用调整表

blocks.en: RoleQ assigns one scale to each vector that reads from the residual stream (a row of W Q W_{Q} , W K W_{K} , W V W_{V} , W gate W_{\mathrm{gate}} , W in W_{\mathrm{in}} ) or writes to it (a column of W O W_{O} , W out W_{\mathrm{out}} ). This rule follows a mechanistic view of the Transformer: the residual stream is a shared communication channel, and components access it through dense read and write vectors. An MLP neuron has read vectors in W in W_{\mathrm{in}} and W gate W_{\mathrm{gate}} and a write vector in W out W_{\mathrm{out}} , corresponding to the key and value of Geva et al. (2021) . Attention reads through Q/K/V rows and writes through O columns, forming the QK and OV circuits of Elhage et al. (2021) . These vectors interact through the stream ( Knittel and Pfister, 2026 ) ; each has a magnitude, direction and functional role. Assigning each vector its own scale separates its magnitude from the direction approximated by its quantization codes. In contrast, a scale per residual coordinate (per-OC on writers, per-IC on readers) couples unrelated units through a shared coordinate. RoleQ therefore aligns the quantization grid with the network’s functional decomposition. In a rotated residual basis, this distinction remains intact: the rotation mixes stream coordinates while preserving the unit axis (Section 3.2 ).

MLP神经元在W_{\mathrm{in}}和Wgate W_{\mathrm{gate}})的W读取矢量,在W outout W_{\mathrm{out}}中读取矢量,对应Geva等人的密钥和值(2021). 注意通过Q/K/V列读取,通过O列写出,形成Elhage等人的QK和OV电路(2021年). 这些向量通过流(Knittel and Pfister, 2026)相互作用;每个向量都有规模,方向和功能作用. 指定每个矢量本身的尺度将它的大小与其量化代码所接近的方向区分开来. 相比之下,每个剩余坐标的尺度(作者为每个OC,读者为每个IC)通过一个共享坐标来表示夫妇不相关的单位. 因此,LocusQ使量化网格与网络的功能分解一致. 在旋转残基中,这种区分保持不变:旋转混合流坐标,同时保留单位轴(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: Standard per-OC placement suits row-major storage and W8A8 accumulators. Weight-only decoding also permits input-axis scales, applied to activations once per token at O ⁡ ( d ) O(d) cost for input width d d , though per-IC placement has remained rare. Prior methods choose the axis by layout or search rather than function. RoleQ uses one rule on integer and ternary grids, readers scale per output unit, writers per input unit (Figure 1 ), with no search, calibration pass or stored per-layer flag. Writer scales lie on the solver’s sweep axis, requiring the adaptation in Section 3.3 . At inference, they simply rescale the input activations.

blocks.en: RoleQ-T rotates weights before quantization using QuaRot’s rotation slots in SpinQuant’s notation ( Ashkboos et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) : r 1 r_{1} on the residual basis, r 2 r_{2} mixing V → \to O per key/value head, and r 4 r_{4} on the MLP intermediate dimension (Appendix F ). We therefore use a rotated residual basis throughout our quantization runs, placement controls and rerun baselines; only the basis control includes unrotated models. Our contribution concerns the rotation objective. blocks.en: 3.4 Scale Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.4 缩放

blocks.en: Scale distillation (+SD) refits only the scales, parametrised as log ⁡ a \log a , and norm gains, 0.02–0.08% of the parameters depending on model size and plane budget (0.024% for the 8B body). It minimises KL divergence from the full-precision teacher’s next-token distribution while keeping codes frozen, preserving the per-unit ternary format. Before quantization, rotation folds RMSNorm’s per-coordinate gains into adjacent weights. SD reintroduces a trainable gain vector at each norm site (two per block and the final norm, +0.0007 bpw), initialised to one, allowing the student to rescale residual coordinates. We use only unlabelled data: 400 steps at batch size 8, or 3,200 windows of 512 tokens from RedPajama-1T-Sample. The teacher’s final residuals are cached once during quantization and mapped to logits by its frozen output head, avoiding teacher forward passes during SD. At 8B, the stage takes 2 h on one A100 (Appendix D ), against 8–64 A100-hours for CAT-Q’s 60-epoch stage at this size and 160 for ScaleQ-1.58’s ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026b ) ; QuIP#-style fine-tuning, which QTIP adopts, is reported at about 100 A100-hours for a 70B model ( Tseng et al., 2024a ; Tseng et al., 2024b ) , and PV-Tuning reports days on eight GPUs at 70B ( Malinovskii et al., 2024 ) . Applying the same SD to a baseline in Section 4.1 tests whether distillation alone explains the recipe’s advantage.

blocks.zh: 3.5 渔业-铺设式二级计划

blocks.en: Sparse secondary planes target the task accuracy and factual knowledge lost in ternary conversion. Existing methods add precision more broadly or on a fixed axis. PTQTP ( Xiao et al., 2025b ) gives every weight a second ternary plane. TWLA’s released code ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , which matches its reported perplexity and task numbers, adds a second plane to 26% of weights, unmentioned in the paper; and QTEA ( Guo et al., 2026 ) adds FP8 residuals to salient columns, the latter two using layer-local saliency. We instead select whole functional units by loss sensitivity: the scaled vectors of Eq. 2 , in every matrix the rows of a reader or the columns of a writer, i.e., neurons and attention dimensions that read from or write to the residual stream. Each selected unit receives a second ternary code and scale on the same axis, 𝒘 ^ = a 1 ​ 𝒕 1 + a 2 ​ 𝒕 2 \hat{{\bm{w}}}=a_{1}{\bm{t}}_{1}+a_{2}{\bm{t}}_{2} , fitted by the same GPTQ to the residual 𝒘 − a 1 ​ 𝒕 1 {\bm{w}}-a_{1}{\bm{t}}_{1} . This represents up to nine levels with 2 ​ log 2 ​ 3 2\log_{2}3 code bits per weight and evaluates as two ternary matmuls and an addition (Appendix E ).

blocks.en: The items used to accumulate the Fisher determine its sensitivity. blocks.en: 4.1 Ternary Conversion Recipe
blocks.zh: 4.1 三级转换食谱

blocks.en: We first ask what quality a few GPU-hours of ternary conversion can retain. Table 1 compares RoleQ-T with ternary methods whose outputs we could evaluate and memory-resident rates establish (Qronos, PT 2 -LLM, QTEA, CAT-Q and TWLA; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026a ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Zhao et al., 2026 ), using each baseline’s best available stage. On Qwen3-8B-Base, RoleQ-T reaches 1.590 bpw with scale distillation in three to four A100 hours, and 2.157 bpw with probing and planes in under ten. Four-level (INT2) grids provide a separate equal-bits comparison in Sections 4.2 and 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们首先询问几小时的地球转录能保留什么质量。 表1比较了作用Q-T与三角方法,我们可以评估其产出并确定内存率(Qronos、PT 2-LLM、QTEA、CAT-Q和TWLA;Zhang等人,2026年;Yan等人,2026年a;Guo等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年c;Zhao等人,2026年),利用每个基准的最佳可用阶段。 在Qune3-8B-Base上,角色Q-T在3到4个A100小时内通过规模蒸馏达到1.590 bpw,在10分钟内通过探测和飞机达到2.157 bpw. 四级(INT2)网格在4.2节和4.3节中提供了单独的等位比较.

blocks.en: At 1.590 bpw, RoleQ-T after scale distillation leads Qronos, PT 2 -LLM and QTEA on all three measures while using matched or fewer bits: the baselines require 1.591, 1.835 and 2.281 bpw, respectively. Adding planes improves all three scores further, still below QTEA’s rate. Knowledge retention distinguishes these methods particularly clearly. Without our distillation, the baselines score 25.9–34.8 on MMLU, close to or modestly above 25% chance accuracy and far below 76.8 at full precision. RoleQ-T retains 47.6 at 1.590 bpw and 62.8 at 2.157 (56.0 before distillation). Perplexity alone therefore gives an incomplete account of the knowledge lost during conversion.
blocks.zh: 在1.590 bpw时,作用Q-T在规模蒸馏后,在使用匹配或更少的比特时,会在所有三项措施上导致Qronos、PT 2-LLM和QTEA:基线分别需要1.591、1.835和2.281 bpw。 加上飞机可以进一步提高所有三个分数,仍低于QTEA的分数. 知识保留特别清楚地区分了这些方法。 没有我们的蒸馏,基线在MMLU上得分为25.9-34.8,接近或略高于25%的概率精确度,完全精确远低于76.8。 作用Q-T在1.590 bpw时保留47.6,在2.157时保留62.8 (蒸馏前保留56.0). 因此,单是复杂性就无法完整地说明转换过程中失去的知识。

blocks.en: Two comparisons delimit this result. First, shared scale distillation does not close the gap: applying it to PT 2 -LLM’s codes yields 15.51 perplexity at 1.835 bpw, versus 11.33 for RoleQ-T at 1.590 (Table 1 ). The advantage thus survives the same distillation procedure, although the quantization recipes differ. Second, comparison with learned ternarization entails a budget trade-off. CAT-Q optimises its codes for 60 epochs on 512 C4 samples, 8–64 A100-hours at 8B by its own bracket (Appendix A ), and its released checkpoint scores 52.9 MMLU at 1.71 bpw on post-trained Qwen3-8B on our harness. Our planes reach 61.8 at 1.99 bpw in under ten GPU-hours: +8.9 points for 0.28 additional bits. At CAT-Q’s own 1.71 bpw, the corresponding RoleQ-T-g128 leads it on perplexity (17.00 vs 27.68) and narrowly on zero-shot (61.7 vs 61.0) and ties on MMLU (53.1 vs 52.9).
blocks.zh: 两次比较确定了这一结果。 首先,共享尺度蒸馏不会缩小这一差距:将其应用到PT 2-LLM的编码中,在1.835 bpw时产生15.51的迷惑性,而作用Q-T在1.590时产生11.33(表1)。 因此,这一优势通过同样的蒸馏程序存在,尽管量化法的配方不同。 第二,与学得的三角化相比较,需要权衡预算。 CAT-Q在512个C4样本上选择60个纪元的代码,8–64 A100小时的8B用自己的括号(Appendix A ),其发布的检查站评分为52.9 MMLU,在训练后的Qune3-8B上为1.71 bpw。 我们的飞机在1.99 bpw时不到10 GPU小时时达到61.8:+8.9分,增加0.28位. 在CAT-QQ’s拥有1.71 bpw时,相应的角色Q-T-g128引导其迷惑性(17.00 vs 27.68)和狭义的零射(61.7 vs 61.0)以及MMLU上的领带(53.1 vs 52.9).

blocks.en:
The gains extend to 14B. With planes and scale distillation, RoleQ-T reaches 8.05 perplexity ( 1.26 × 1.26\times full precision), 69.2 zero-shot and 68.3 MMLU at 2.156 bpw, versus 11.78, 56.6 and 47.8 for QTEA’s released checkpoint at 2.26. At the matched PTQ stage, before distillation, the planes run still leads on all three measures (10.11, 65.7 and 62.0), with each gap at least 19 × 19\times our seed range. This includes WikiText2, QTEA’s calibration corpus. The one-plane run at 1.589 bpw also leads after distillation (9.53 / 65.4 / 59.7), saving 0.67 bpw, but trails at PTQ. The lower-rate advantage therefore depends on distillation; the planes advantage holds at both stages. TWLA ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) is a higher-rate reference: it releases no checkpoint, and its released code, which reproduces its reported Qwen3-8B perplexity, builds a masked two-plane model its paper does not describe, resident at 4.15–4.65 bpw, roughly twice our planes rate (Table 1 , Appendix A ).
Section 5 discusses the stronger trellis-coded results at matched bits on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (Appendix Table 10 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 The Placement Rule
blocks.zh: 4.2 安置规则

blocks.en:
Table 2 isolates scale placement: within each grid and model, the placements share the solver, random Hadamard r 1 r_{1} , calibration draw and paired seeds, with no distillation.
At ternary, RoleQ has the lowest mean perplexity at every tested size in both families, improving on the best uniform placement by up to 2 × 2\times , with the same ordering on every seed from 1.7B upward.
At 14B, the gain also appears on both task measures: 52.3 versus 45.6 zero-shot and 38.5 versus chance-level 25.4 MMLU for per-OC (Appendix Table 7 ). The 0.6B and Qwen-8B perplexity gaps remain within the largest seed range.
Integer grids show the same mean perplexity ordering, but the margin depends on alphabet size and model.
On the four-level grid, the best uniform placement has 1.19 × 1.19\times RoleQ’s perplexity at 1.7B and 1.22 × 1.22\times on Llama-8B, versus about 1.01 × 1.01\times at Qwen-8B and 14B.
At INT3 and INT4, the largest gains occur at 1.7B: ratios of 2.19 × 2.19\times and 1.14 × 1.14\times , respectively.
Placement thus matters most at ternary, where the per-unit scale is a unit’s only continuous degree of freedom; here the benefit persists to the largest tested model in each family.
Two practical comparisons follow. RoleQ-INT4 matches or improves on MXFP4 ( Open Compute Project, 2023 ; Rouhani et al., 2023 ) perplexity at 0.6B, 1.7B and 8B while using 8% fewer bits (information bits, Appendix A ).
The rule also comes within 0.023% of AdaDim’s ( Heo et al., 2024 ) searched 𝐇 \mathbf{H} -metric reconstruction error at half the solver work of a two-way GPTQ search, without calibration data for axis selection or stored axis flags. This is a reconstruction comparison, not an end-to-end AdaDim evaluation. Appendix C controls for codes, scale count and fitting procedure, and shows that the rule’s advantage depends on rotation.

blocks.en: 4.3 Sparse Secondary Planes
blocks.zh: 4.3 Sparse二级计划

blocks.en:
Secondary planes recover much of the knowledge lost in single-plane conversion for a fraction of a bit. At 8B, +0.57 bpw of text-Fisher planes recovers about half the MMLU loss: scores rise from 33.3 to 56.0 at PTQ and from 47.6 to 62.8 after scale distillation, against 76.8 at full precision. After distillation, perplexity improves from 11.33 to 9.30 (Appendix Table 9 ). At 14B, planes raise MMLU from 44.7 to 62.0 at PTQ and from 59.7 to 68.3 after distillation, with zero-shot gains of 10.2 and 3.8 points. All six 14B gains exceed four seed ranges, but five are smaller than their 8B counterparts (Table 1 ), suggesting greater benefit where single-plane conversion loses more quality.
Placement determines how much this budget recovers (Table 3 ). At 1.99 bpw on post-trained Qwen3-8B, knowledge-Fisher selection beats random placement by 6.2 MMLU points and Hessian × \times weight by 9.0; the latter falls below random. On post-trained 1.7B, the full selector set separates by score family (Appendix Table 12 ): loss-sensitivity scores yield 9.7–10.3 PTQ perplexity, versus 13.7–17.9 for error-magnitude scores, with random placement in the latter range. The 1.7B budget sweep supports this distinction: random placement’s perplexity relative to Fisher falls from 1.96 × 1.96\times at + 0.15 +0.15 bits to 1.12 × 1.12\times at + 0.9 +0.9 (Appendix Figure 3 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced RoleQ, which assigns quantization scales to functional units, and RoleQ-T, which converts existing checkpoints to ternary in a few GPU-hours. Two findings stand out. First, the Transformer’s division of labour into readers and writers provides a structural rule for scale placement. In a rotated basis, this rule requires no axis search, calibration data or stored axis choices, and its benefits persist to the largest models tested. Second, post-training conversion can retain useful task accuracy below two bits per weight. RoleQ-T outperforms the tested ternary conversion baselines at matched or lower memory-resident rates, with the largest gains in factual knowledge, which perplexity alone does not capture. Fisher-guided secondary planes further recover knowledge by directing a fraction of a bit to loss-sensitive units. Together, these results offer a practical route to lower memory use and multiplication-free ternary matrix products while preserving useful model capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LocusQ,它给功能单位分配了量化尺度,以及LocusQ-T,它将现有的检查站在几小时GPU转换为ternary. 有两个发现是突出的。 首先,变形人对读者和作家的分工为规模布局提供了结构性规则. 在旋转的基础上,这一规则要求不进行轴搜索,校准数据或存储轴选择,其好处持续到测试的最大模型. 第二,训练后转换可以将有用的任务精度保留在每重量2位以下. 作用Q-T以匹配或较低的内存-内存率,超过测试的三重转换基线,在事实知识中收益最大,单是模糊性并不能捕捉到. 费舍尔制导的二级飞机通过将一点一点引导到对损失敏感的单位来进一步恢复知识. 这些结果共同为降低内存使用率和无倍增效应的三角矩阵产品提供了实用途径,同时保留了有用的模型能力.

blocks.en: These findings have a defined scope. The placement rule is supported in a rotated basis; its advantage does not extend to native coordinates. Four Qwen3 sizes and one Llama model do not establish a general scaling trend, and the best uniform placement varies with size and family. Fisher selection’s advantage over random placement narrows with increasing budget in the 1.7B sweep. The gains from adding planes are also generally smaller at 14B than at 8B at the same total rate. At 2 bpw on Llama, QTIP’s trellis codes, alone and with GuidedQuant’s Hessian ( Tseng et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2025 ) , remain ahead (Appendix Table 10 ), so we do not claim parity with this codebook class. Our evaluations do not cover generation or reasoning, including long chains of thought, where quantization introduces distinct failure modes ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . Our results are weight-only (A16) and measure storage and quality, not inference speed. The ternary inner loop requires no multiplier, codebook or group metadata, making evaluation with lookup-table kernels ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) a natural next step (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果具有明确的范围。 安置规则在轮换的基础上得到支持;其优势并不扩展到本土坐标. 4个Quen3尺寸和一个Llama模型没有建立总的缩放趋势,最佳的统一布置随尺寸和家庭而异. 费舍尔选择优于随机投放, 增加飞机的增益在14B时一般也比8B时的总增速小. 在Llama上的2 bpw, QTIP的Trellis代码, 单独和与GuidedQuant的Hessian(Tseng等人, 2024b; Kim等人, 2025 ), 仍然领先(Appendix表10), 所以我们不主张与这个代码簿类相当。 我们的评价不包括产生或推理,包括长的思维链,其中量化引入了不同的失败模式(Liu等人,2025a)。 我们的结果只有重量(A16),衡量储存和质量,而不是推论速度。 三角内环不需要乘数,代码本或组元数据,使得带有望表内核的评价(Wang等人,2025年;Wei等人,2025年)是一个自然的下一步(附录A).

blocks.en: The broader lesson concerns allocation. At very low precision, both scale sharing and the placement of additional bits shape knowledge retention. Under tight budgets, allocating precision to the right units can matter more than increasing the overall rate. A low-bit format should therefore be judged by both how many bits it spends and where it spends them.
blocks.zh: 更广泛的经验教训涉及分配。 在非常低的精度下,比例分享和附加比特的布置都会塑造知识保留. 在预算紧张的情况下,向合适的单位分配精确度比提高整体比率更重要。 因此,低位格式应该从它花费的位数和它花费的地方来判断.

Tables 1 and 4 record the stage of every run, and every comparison in the paper is either stage-aligned or names both stages.

blocks.en: Ternary weights offer two savings rather than one. (i) Memory traffic scales with bpw; it is identical for every format at equal bits and is the saving today’s GPUs realise. (ii) An integer weight at any width still multiplies (dequantize-and-FMA or an integer MAC, plus a scale and zero point every group), whereas a ternary weight adds the activation, subtracts it or skips it: no multiplier, no codebook and no group metadata in the inner loop. The per-vector scale costs one multiply per output or input coordinate, O ⁡ ( d ) O(d) per token against O ⁡ ( d 2 ) O(d^{2}) additions, and a second plane costs two accumulations and an add. Binary weights share this property but have no zero; four-level and wider grids do not have it. The second saving is realised today on CPUs by lookup-table kernels ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) and is the premise of add-only hardware, for which BitNet b1.58 estimates about 70 × 70\times lower matmul arithmetic energy than fp16 at 7 nm ( Ma et al., 2024 ) . We report no latency or energy measurements of our own (Section 5 ).

blocks.en: Four controls separate the placement effect from what it could be confounded with. The code and the scale count. On the four-level g128 grid, which changes both the code and the number of scales, the ordering RoleQ < < per-OC < < per-IC reproduces at every Qwen size, including 14B (10.76, 10.90, 11.64). At 1.7B both halves of the margin, the writer half (RoleQ against per-OC, which differ only on writers) and the reader half (RoleQ against per-IC, which differ only on readers), lie well outside the seed spread (19% and 30%); at 14B only the reader half does (8.2% at 2.9 × 2.9\times the seed range, against 1.3% at 0.5 × 0.5\times for the writer half). On Llama-8B the role and per-OC placements of the same grid tie in the recipe basis (Table 11 ), so on the four-level grid the ordering is established for Qwen only. The fit. Two different ternary fits give the same ordering within noise. The rotation. AdaDim’s per-layer search agrees with the placement rule on 96.4% of the cells in the rotated basis and on 14.3% unrotated (Table 8 ): the axis the rule fixes is the one a reconstruction-error search prefers only after rotation, which is why we state it as a rotated-basis rule (Section 3.2 ). The reference placement. The best uniform placement changes with size and family (per-IC at Qwen-8B, per-OC at 14B and on Llama), so every margin in the paper is reported against it. Llama-8B is the only cell in which both halves separate at once (writer 1.97 × 1.97\times , reader 11.52 × 11.52\times ), between two runs at 9.2 × 9.2\times and 18.2 × 18.2\times full precision. As a consistency check, the 8B placement runs, PTQ-only under r 1 r_{1} and carried out separately from the recipe ladder, reproduce the corresponding bodies seed by seed (RoleQ 30.7 / 31.5 against 31.0 / 31.0, the r 1 r_{1} PTQ row of Table 9 ; per-OC 36.0 / 35.0 against 35.4 / 34.9).

blocks.en: The stage has two hyper-parameters, the number of steps T T and the batch size B B ; every window is seen once, so together they fix the number of documents at T ⋅ B T\cdot B . We use T = 400 T=400 and B = 8 B=8 at a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} , drawing from RedPajama-1T-Sample, the corpus on which QuIP#, AQLM and EfficientQAT fine-tune ( Tseng et al., 2024a ; Egiazarian et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , while calibration stays on C4. We fix 400 steps because the returns flatten quickly: at 8B the 1.59-bpw body improves from 31.0 to 12.9 perplexity in the first 100 steps and from 12.4 to 12.0 in the last 200. The teacher is never run during training; its final residuals are cached once during quantization and unembedded with the frozen head, which lets the stage fit beside the student on a single GPU.

blocks.en: Ternary group scales ( g = 128 g=128 , +0.12 bpw) improve the body at either placement (Table 9 ). With the groups per output row, the standard layout, the run scores 10.87 / 61.93 / 51.33 after scale distillation; with the same groups on the role axis (RoleQ-T-g128) it scores 10.82 / 61.81 / 50.89, within ± 3 \pm 3 % on every instrument and with the sign flipping between seeds on two of them. At PTQ the role-axis variant is ahead on all three instruments (18.49 against 19.16 perplexity, +1.2 zero-shot, +2.6 MMLU), by less than 3 × 3\times the seed range. With group scales, then, the role axis is on par with the standard placement rather than ahead of it.

blocks.en: For readers the two scales of a unit with a second plane are re-solved jointly by an exact 2 × 2 2\times 2 weighted least squares in the Σ \Sigma metric, which decouples per unit because Σ \Sigma acts on the input axis. For writers there is no joint refit: 𝐇 \mathbf{H} acts on the axis the scales index, so the exact refit is one coupled 2 ​ n × 2 ​ n 2n\times 2n system and a per-unit shortcut would cancel 𝐇 \mathbf{H} out; the coupling is handled inside the GPTQ recursion instead.

blocks.en: The scored span is the chat-rendered answer tokens of a knowledge item (end marker included, as the evaluation scores it) or the second half of each 384-token C4 window; prompt tokens serve as context and are never scored. The Fisher is accumulated in fp32 over every quantized weight, one forward-backward pass per item over 720 items, and kept in two interleaved item halves for the split-half check (17 GB of host memory at 1.7B; probes at 8B and above need an H200). The budget over the one-plane body targets 2.156 bpw for the Base rows ( + 0.556 +0.556 / 0.562 0.562 / 0.566 0.566 / 0.567 0.567 code bits at 0.6B / 1.7B / 8B / 14B and Llama-8B) and 1.994 for the post-trained rows ( + 0.40 +0.40 ); (layer, kind) cells whose selected fraction falls below 2% are dropped as noise, which leaves about 180–200 cells with a second plane. blocks.en: The budget sweep (Figure 3 ) and the full selector set (Table 12 ) are measured on the post-trained 1.7B model. Spearman correlation with realized per-unit PTQ error does not predict useful placement: Hessian × \times weight correlates strongly ( ρ = + 0.96 \rho=+0.96 ) yet performs worst among selectors, while the knowledge Fisher anti-correlates ( ρ = − 0.47 \rho=-0.47 ) and performs much better. Error magnitude alone therefore appears insufficient to identify the units that benefit most from extra precision. The item set decides what is recovered, which is why the score is conditioned on it at all: on that model the text Fisher is best on perplexity and worst on factual recall, the knowledge Fisher the reverse, and the checkpoint on which the score is computed changes only the size of the effect.
